status_summary: S. 1371, the S-CAP Act of 2025 (Sen. Boozman, introduced 2025-04-09, referred to the Finance Committee), would raise the S corporation shareholder limit in IRC section 1361(b)(1)(A) from 100 to 250 for taxable years beginning after 2025; it does not mention crowdfunding or Regulation A shareholders, so it is a different approach to the same constraint. The section as published by Cornell's Legal Information Institute still sets the limit at 100 and lists no 2025 amendment.

timeline.event: S. 1371 was introduced to raise the S corporation shareholder limit from 100 to 250 and referred to the Senate Finance Committee.
